name: Tottori (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with a white soaring-bird mark.
history: The flag of Tottori bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Tottori municipal emblem — a white soaring-bird mark
features.symbolism: a flying bird (tobu tori) — a rebus on the city's name
